title: Cavendish Yellow / Color Palette

location.extent: Complete photographed spread from one GIF frame

slide_intent: Give a primary color a defined role because repeated use can create recognition while supporting colors allow variety.
strategic_value: Cavendish Yellow can connect Mailchimp’s humor and optimism with a recognizable identity across applications.
demonstration: A yellow left page explains the hero color and prints its values; a three-column, five-row palette of named swatches occupies the right page.
practical_value: Distinguish hero-color intent from palette membership without inventing usage ratios.

content_islands.name: Rationale and values
content_islands.spec: Place the large rationale above the small Cavendish specifications on the yellow left page.

content_islands.name: Palette
content_islands.spec: Arrange fifteen named swatches in three columns on the right page.

content_islands.name: Folio
content_islands.spec: Retain printed folio 64 and Version 1.0 footer.

reference_purposes.Intent: The visible copy connects yellow with optimism, humor, consistency and accumulated recognition.
reference_purposes.Application: The spread establishes yellow as the hero color and permits pairing it with a secondary system.

ingredient.name: Cavendish Yellow
ingredient.role: Provide the primary point of color recognition.
ingredient.application: Use yellow where clear brand recognition matters, pairing it with secondary colors for flexibility as the source explains.
ingredient.scope: Historical Version 1.0 excerpt. No ratio is given. The photographed values read RGB 255/224/27, HEX #FFE01B, CMYK 2/8/96/0 and PMS 108 C / 108 U; other case-study assets use slightly different yellow pixels, so do not sample them as the printed specification.
